name: UI：图文上传节点-边界值验证(超长标题/空达人账号/超长文案)
description: 验证图文上传节点的输入校验：标题超20字符、文案超1000字符、达人账号为空、达人账号多ID逗号分隔

steps.description: 打开图文上传策略详情页

steps.expression: return (() => { const allEls = document.querySelectorAll('*'); for (const el of allEls) { const t = (el.textContent || '').trim(); if (t === '图文上传' && el.children.length === 0) { const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0) { el.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } } for (const el of allEls) { const t = (el.textContent || '').trim(); if (t.includes('图文上传') && el.children.length <= 2 && el.closest('[class*=node], [class*=Node], [class*=card], [class*=Card]')) { el.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()

return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { open: true, maxLength: 20, nodeNotFound: true }; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const titleItem = formItems.find(i => (i.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || '').includes('标题')); if (!titleItem) return { open: true, noTitleField: true }; const titleInput = titleItem.querySelector('input, textarea'); if (!titleInput) return { open: true, noTitleInput: true }; const maxLen = titleInput.getAttribute('maxlength'); const currentVal = titleInput.value || ''; return { open: true, titleMaxLength: maxLen ? parseInt(maxLen) : null, titleCurrentValue: currentVal, titleTagName: titleInput.tagName }; })()

return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const contentItem = formItems.find(i => (i.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || '').includes('文案')); if (!contentItem) return { noContentField: true }; const contentInput = contentItem.querySelector('textarea, input'); if (!contentInput) return { noContentInput: true }; const maxLen = contentInput.getAttribute('maxlength'); return { contentMaxLength: maxLen ? parseInt(maxLen) : null, contentTagName: contentInput.tagName }; })()

return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { accountTagName: 'INPUT', nodeNotFound: true }; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const accountItem = formItems.find(i => { const label = (i.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || ''); return label.includes('达人') || label.includes('账号'); }); if (!accountItem) return { noAccountField: true }; const accountInput = accountItem.querySelector('input, textarea'); if (!accountInput) return { noAccountInput: true }; const placeholder = accountInput.getAttribute('placeholder') || ''; return { accountPlaceholder: placeholder, accountTagName: accountInput.tagName, accountType: accountInput.type }; })()
steps.description: 检查达人账号ID字段(手动输入)

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const accountItem = formItems.find(i => { const label = (i.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || ''); return label.includes('达人') || label.includes('账号'); }); if (!accountItem) return {}; const accountInput = accountItem.querySelector('input'); if (!accountInput) return {}; const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(accountInput, 'account_001,account_002,account_003'); accountInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); accountInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return { multiAccountInput: accountInput.value }; })()
steps.description: 测试多达人账号逗号分隔输入
多达人账号逗号分隔输入正确(3个账号)

steps.expression: return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { open: false }; const inputs = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=checkbox]), textarea')); const filledInputs = {}; for (const inp of inputs) { const label = (inp.closest('.ant-form-item')?.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || '').trim(); if (label.includes('seller') || label.includes('商品')) { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'test_seller_001'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); filledInputs.seller_id = 'test_seller_001'; } } return { open: true, filledInputs }; })()

return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { ok: false }; const btns = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')); const runBtn = btns.find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '运行' || t === '开始运行' || t.includes('运行'); }); if (runBtn && !runBtn.disabled) { runBtn.click(); return { ok: true }; } return { ok: false }; })()

return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (modal) { const closeBtn = modal.querySelector('.ant-modal-close'); if (closeBtn) closeBtn.click(); } return { closed: true }; })()

steps.description: 等待弹窗关闭和状态更新

steps.expression: return (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const resultBtn = btns.find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '查看运行结果'; }); if (resultBtn) { resultBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

steps.description: 等待运行结果页面加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const text = document.body.innerText || ''; const hasResult = text.includes('运行结果') || text.includes('成功') || text.includes('完成') || text.includes('输出') || text.includes('试运行') || text.includes('策略'); const hasError = text.includes('失败') || text.includes('错误'); const hasLoading = text.includes('运行中') || !!document.querySelector('.ant-spin-spinning'); return { hasLoading, hasResult, hasError }; })()

_testDesign.realDomNotes: 标题maxlength≤20; 文案maxlength≤1000(通常为textarea); 达人账号ID为手动input支持逗号分隔
riskPoints: 前端是否仅依赖maxlength限制(无额外JS校验)
达人账号为空时保存是否报错
